findings.title: The essay doesn't name the conversation it is in — and its educated readers live there
findings.body: Its thesis, §XIII, §XV and its declared philosophical center each have famous predecessors it never names; at this venue that converts synthesis into apparent rediscovery. Direction: name the coinage's lineage (Balkin's National Surveillance State, coercive capacity), a Solove sentence in §XIII, a Pettit sentence in §XI, Brandeis in §XV.

findings.title: The injury is the thesis, and it is the least-evidenced thing in the piece — Posner's counterargument unanswered
findings.body: The central injury claim (anticipatory chilling) is the least-evidenced element, and the strongest published counterargument (Posner's collection/use distinction) goes unanswered. The independent second read, given only the draft, reached the same verdict on independent grounds.

findings.title: "Shown to a grand jury" (opening): re-attribute to Minnesota Reformer
findings.body: Minnesota Reformer's report, not AP's; re-attribute or soften — see Major issue 3.
